data.one_liner: Easily block or unblock the UI with loading states in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides an easy way to block and unblock user interaction and display loading overlays or async builders in Flutter apps. Can be used imperatively via static methods or declaratively as a widget.
use_when: You want to prevent user navigation and interaction during asynchronous operations or loading.
You need a simple global loading overlay with customizable widgets and text.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions.
You only need progress indicators inside specific localized layout areas without blocking the screen.
strengths: Simple one-line API for blocking and unblocking UI globally.
Supports custom loaders, text widgets, and transitions.
Can also be used as a widget with future-based states.
weaknesses: Relies on overlay/modal barriers which might interfere with certain navigation stacks if misused.
Limited to basic UI blocking and loading display.
